task:
A two-door coupe body blocked out from photos: one smooth skinned shell (cq skin through cross-sections along z, nose at z=0, y up from the ground) with four wheel arches, plus four wheels as a second body. Every catalogue row is an envelope the body must hit: overall length, body width, roof height, ground clearance. Wheels sit on the ground and clear their arches.

Catalogue (mm; one row per configuration):
variant,length,width,height,ground,wheel_d
photo estimate,4400,2000,1150,110,720

name: build_cad

input.code:
import smlibquery as sq
hw = width / 2
g = ground
H = height
L = length
wr = wheel_d / 2
zf = 0.2 * L
zr = 0.78 * L
arch_r = wr + 45
wheel_w = 240
wx = hw - wheel_w / 2 - 40
secs = [
    (0, 0.72 * hw, g + 120, g + 380, 0.2),
    (0.03 * L, 0.90 * hw, g + 40, g + 500, 0.2),
    (0.10 * L, 0.98 * hw, g, 0.60 * H, 0.22),
    (0.25 * L, hw, g, 0.65 * H, 0.25),
    (0.36 * L, hw, g, 0.72 * H, 0.3),
    (0.46 * L, hw, g, 0.95 * H, 0.4),
    (0.55 * L, hw, g, H, 0.42),
    (0.65 * L, hw, g, 0.97 * H, 0.42),
    (0.78 * L, hw, g, 0.78 * H, 0.35),
    (0.90 * L, 0.97 * hw, g, 0.74 * H, 0.3),
    (0.97 * L, 0.90 * hw, g + 40, 0.70 * H, 0.25),
    (L, 0.80 * hw, g + 120, 0.62 * H, 0.2),
]
shell = sq.Workplane("XY").skin(secs, exponent=3).tag("body.shell")
def_len = 420
a1 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(def_len, arch_r).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((hw, wr, zf))
a2 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(def_len, arch_r).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((-hw, wr, zf))
a3 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(def_len, arch_r).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((hw, wr, zr))
a4 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(def_len, arch_r).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((-hw, wr, zr))
body = shell.cut(a1).cut(a2).cut(a3).cut(a4)
w1 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(wheel_w, wr).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((wx, wr, zf))
w2 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(wheel_w, wr).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((-wx, wr, zf))
w3 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(wheel_w, wr).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((wx, wr, zr))
w4 = sq.Workplane("XY").cylinder(wheel_w, wr).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), 90).translate((-wx, wr, zr))
wheels = w1.union(w2).union(w3).union(w4).tag("wheels.tire")
result = sq.Assembly().add(body, name="body", loc=sq.Location((0, 0, 0))).add(wheels, name="wheels", loc=sq.Location((0, 0, 0)))
